values.note: 'Campsites may be reserved anytime online, by phone, or at the campground office.' Two nights minimum on Friday+Saturday, one night allowed Sunday-Thursday; the booking site sold one-night weeknight stays (Oct 2026, Apr, May, Jun and Aug 2027) and refused a one-night Friday. Only River Run's electric sites were offered for 2027-04-20 (Cokeley not yet open).

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/north-bend-state-park/lodging/camping-at-north-bend-state-park/ ('Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday and Saturday) or one night Sunday through Thursday.'; 'There is a 14-night maximum stay.') + book.wvstateparks.com suppliers 11067625/7989192 (one night 2026-10-27: 46 electric, 2027-04-20: 25 River Run only, 2027-05-11, 2027-06-15, 2027-08-10: 51-53; one night Fri 2027-06-18 none; 2027-06-18/20: 48), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booking site, Oct 2026 to Aug 2027: electric sites in both campgrounds $44.99 a night, weeknights and weekends alike. River Run also sells 23 non-electric sites at $24.99 ($29.99 on a Friday-Saturday stay); the park page does not say whether they take RVs.

fees.source: book.wvstateparks.com supplier 11067625 'North Bend State Park Electric Campsites' (Cokeley and River Run, $44.99) and 7989192 'North Bend State Park Non-electric Campsites' (River Run, $24.99; $29.99 for 2027-06-18/20), read 2026-10-21

summary: Park page + booking site: confirmed the inherited booking rules (2-night weekend minimum, 14-night max; one-night weeknights sell online) into the entry; electric $44.99 unchanged, fee note corrected (River Run also sells 23 non-electric sites at $24.99, so not every site has electric); added 30/50-amp + water, 77 sites in two campgrounds, Wi-Fi, laundry; spring-fall season.
flags: Fees base: River Run's 23 non-electric sites sell at $24.99 ($29.99 on a weekend stay), but the park page doesn't say whether they fit an RV, so the base was left at the electric $44.99. If they take a 23-ft rig, nightly_low should be 24.99.
